instruction.text: Select the angle that matches the description.

atoms.a: An acute angle is formed when the lines are close to each other. It is a narrow angle.

wrong1.text: These lines are perpendicular to each other. An acute angle is narrower.

wrong2.text: These lines are far away from each other. You need a narrower angle.

atoms.a: A right angle is a quarter turn. It is formed when the lines are perpendicular to each other.

wrong1.text: These lines are close to each other. A right angle is wider.

wrong2.text: These lines are far away from each other. A right angle is narrower.

atoms.a: An obtuse angle is formed when the lines are far away from each other. It is a wide angle.

wrong1.text: These lines are close to each other. An obtuse angle is wider.

wrong2.text: These lines are perpendicular to each other. An obtuse angle is wider.
